tools.name: chargerdojo_describe_access
tools.description: Explain what this server can do, which tools are open to anyone, which need your ChargerDojo account, and each plan with its price and what it unlocks. Answers: what can I do here, what does my plan include, and how do I connect my account.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_ocpi_versions
tools.description: List the OCPI versions ChargerDojo covers, with what each one is for and which modules are implemented. Answers: which OCPI versions can I test against.

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_ocpi_version
tools.description: Describe one OCPI version: how the credentials token is encoded, whether endpoints split into sender and receiver, which modules are implemented, and what the known limits are. Answers: how does this OCPI version work on the wire.

tools.name: chargerdojo_compare_ocpi_versions
tools.description: Compare two OCPI versions: what changed in the protocol between them, and which modules ChargerDojo gained. Answers: what changes when I move from one OCPI version to another.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_journey_templates
tools.description: List the OCPI charging journeys, each with the role it tests, its OCPI versions, the modules the endpoint must offer, the plan it needs against your own endpoint, and how long it runs on the sandbox. Filter by version and role. Answers: which journeys test my role at my OCPI version.

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_usage
tools.description: Report the plan on this account and how much of each ceiling is left: targets, API keys, runs in flight, run rate and report retention. Answers: which plan am I on, and how close am I to its limits.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_targets
tools.description: List the OCPI endpoints registered on this account, 25 a page, with each one's OCPI version, roles and registration status, or read one by id. Answers: which endpoints can I run against.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_runs
tools.description: List the conformance runs and charging journeys on this account, newest first and 25 a page, with their status and pass and fail counts, narrowed by target, status or OCPI version. Answers: what ran recently, and how did it go.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_conformance_suites
tools.description: List the OCPI conformance suites that can be run, grouped by version and module, with how many checks each carries. Answers: what does a conformance run check at my OCPI version.

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_run_verdict
tools.description: Read the verdict of one conformance run or charging journey on this account: how many checks passed, failed and warned, and whether anything graded at all. Answers: did this run pass.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_checks
tools.description: List the checks a conformance run of one OCPI module grades at one version: each check id, what it sends, each rule as required or optional with its strength, and the clause of the OCPI spec each rule is graded against, quoted. Answers: what will ChargerDojo hold my module to, and where does the spe

tools.name: chargerdojo_validate_payload
tools.description: Check one OCPI object, sent as JSON text, against the schema ChargerDojo grades that object with at one OCPI version, and list each field that breaks it. The JSON leaves your machine and is sent to chargerdojo.com; it is not stored or logged. Up to 64 KB, 30 calls a minute. Answers: is this a valid

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_run_checks
tools.description: Read the checks of one conformance run on this account that failed, could not be graded or carried a warning, each with the rule it broke and the clause of the OCPI spec it was graded against, quoted. Answers: why did this run fail, and what does the spec say.

tools.name: chargerdojo_compare_run
tools.description: Compare one conformance run with the previous comparable run against the same endpoint, OCPI version and module: which checks newly fail, which recovered, and which stopped being graded. Answers: what changed since my last run.

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_schedule
tools.description: Read the recurring run set on one target: its cadence, whether it is on or paused and why, when it runs next, and what its last run found. Schedules are set in the app, on the Automate plan. Answers: is my endpoint tested on a schedule, and did its last run pass.

tools.name: chargerdojo_get_journey_events
tools.description: Read what happened during a charging journey on this account, step by step, with which assertions passed at each step. Answers: what happened at each step of this journey.

tools.name: chargerdojo_cancel_run
tools.description: Stop a charging journey that is still running on this account. It stops at the next safe point and keeps whatever it already graded. Answers: how do I stop a journey that is still running.

tools.name: chargerdojo_list_runnable_journeys
tools.description: List the charging journeys that can run against one target on this account, say why the target supports them, and name the plan any of them needs that this account does not have. Answers: which journeys fit this endpoint, by its role and version.

tools.name: chargerdojo_run_sandbox_journey
tools.description: Run an OCPI charging journey against a sandbox endpoint. Answers: how do I try a journey without an endpoint of my own.

tools.name: chargerdojo_run_journey
tools.description: Run an OCPI charging journey against an endpoint registered on this account, the sandbox or your own, and return its report id. Against your own endpoint it needs the Integrate plan, and a few journeys need a higher one, which chargerdojo_list_journey_templates names. Answers: does my endpoint pass

tools.name: chargerdojo_start_conformance_run
tools.description: Start a conformance run against an endpoint registered on this account, the sandbox or your own: one module, or every module the endpoint offers. Returns the report id at once. Against your own endpoint it needs the Integrate plan, and a module sold on a higher plan names it. Answers: does my endpoi

tools.name: chargerdojo_send_feedback
tools.description: Send a message to the people who build ChargerDojo: something missing, a bug, a question, or a verdict the person believes is wrong. Returns a reference.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "chargerdojo_get_ocpi_version" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
